state.paragraph: As part of its ongoing review of strategic alternatives, at an in-person meeting of the Board on April 5, 2013, the Board discussed the sale of CSC to Pamplona as well as industry-wide merger and acquisition activity and dynamics, and authorized Mac-Gray management to work with BofA Merrill Lynch to explore transactional opportunities that might be available to Mac-Gray, including opportunities with another strategic party, whom we refer to as Party A, in the laundry facilities management industry. The Board also determined to further consider Mac-Gray's strategic alternatives at its meeting scheduled for May 9, 2013.
state.target_sentence: As part of its ongoing review of strategic alternatives, at an in-person meeting of the Board on April 5, 2013, the Board discussed the sale of CSC to Pamplona as well as industry-wide merger and acquisition activity and dynamics, and authorized Mac-Gray management to work with BofA Merrill Lynch to explore transactional opportunities that might be available to Mac-Gray, including opportunities with another strategic party, whom we refer to as Party A, in the laundry facilities management industry.

criteria.row_2: 10/23/2012 | BofA Merrill Lynch | Adviser | Target's financial adviser, hired for Mac-Gray's possible purchase of CSC (2011-2012 Discussions), not for a sale. On 04/05/2013 the board had it explore opportunities, including with Party A.
criteria.row_3: 04/08/2013 | Party A | Target interest | Board authorized this on 04/05 as part of exploring opportunities. Party A said it might consider a combination. Party A is a laundry facilities management company.
criteria.row_4: 05/09/2013 | Goodwin Procter LLP | Adviser | Target's outside legal counsel, first seen acting here. Later also advised the Special Committee.
criteria.none: None of the ledger rows records the event reported in the target sentence, either as the row's own event or in its note.
criteria.not_an_event: The target sentence reports no discrete event of these kinds (background, reasoning, description or discussion only).

match.instructions: `target_sentence` (from a merger filing; `paragraph` gives context) appears to report that a financial or legal adviser is retained, engaged, terminated or first shown acting for the target, a committee or a bidder. Each option describes one row of a research ledger as date | party | event | note. Select the row that records the event reported in `target_sentence`: same party or group, same action, consistent date and terms, allowing paraphrase and allowing the event to be summarised in a row's note. A related event with a different party, date or action does not count.
